subject.title: Add Atomic Chat as a bundled local provider (OpenAI-compatible, 127.0.0.1:1337)

question: Should Atomic Chat be accepted as a bundled enabled-by-default OpenClaw provider, or should it remain an external ClawHub/provider plugin with custom-provider documentation?
rationale: Current main supports custom OpenAI-compatible providers and external provider plugins, while VISION.md sets a high bar for optional bundled plugins; choosing the permanent surface is a maintainer product decision, not a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Route Atomic Chat External
options.body: Close the bundled-provider direction and ask the contributor to publish a provider plugin through ClawHub/npm while keeping docs for the custom-provider path.

options.title: Sponsor Bundled Provider
options.body: Keep this issue open, approve Atomic Chat as bundled provider surface, and require the linked implementation PR to fix its review, dependency, and routing blockers before merge.

options.title: Land Docs-Only First
options.body: Use the docs-only PR as the user-facing path now and defer bundled-provider promotion until demand or maintainer ownership is clearer.

recommendation.title: Route Atomic Chat External
recommendation.body: Close the bundled-provider direction and ask the contributor to publish a provider plugin through ClawHub/npm while keeping docs for the custom-provider path.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about core/plugin product scope and current blame/CODEOWNERS point to steipete for the relevant vision and provider-surface policy.
